frames.narration: OrderService needs ada's open orders. It holds only the OrderRepository interface.
It asks the repository like a collection: findOpenFor('ada').
The concrete repository runs whatever the store needs: a filter in memory, or a SQL query.
Orders come back as domain objects, not rows. The service never saw the query.
The service cancels order #1 and the entity changes its own status.
Swap SQL for an API: one new repository class. OrderService is not edited.
